sources.title: The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks
sources.authors_or_publisher: Kenneth C. Gross, Chien Yi Wang, and Mikal Saltveit, editors; USDA Agricultural Research Service
sources.retrieval_operation: Opened USDA-ARS PDF and searched/read the initial-cooling passage in web PDF text.
sources.locator: PDF pp.20–24; 'Initial Cooling Methods', especially pp.20–21.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Special facilities are used to remove produce heat; the handbook says highway trailers have insufficient airflow for dependable initial cooling and describes crop/package-dependent methods.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Commodity and package dependent; forced-air is broadly adaptable, while method choice has exceptions.
sources.applicability: Supports investigating initial product condition and package-compatible preconditioning before transport-cooling purchase.
sources.limitations: General handbook, not case measurements or a target for unknown produce.

sources.title: Protecting Perishable Foods During Transport by Truck or Rail
sources.authors_or_publisher: Jeffrey K. Brecht, Steven Sargent, Patrick E. Brecht, Jorge Saenz, and Leonard Rodowick; University of Florida IFAS Extension
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current HTML publication viewed 2026-10-10; no revision date displayed. Preface describes prior handbook lineage.
sources.retrieval_operation: Opened UF/IFAS HTML and searched/read product-vs-air and recorder guidance passages.
sources.locator: Sections 'Air Temperature vs. Product Temperature' and 'Temperature Recording and Tracking'; the loading/temperature section describes three-position cargo guidance.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Cargo air changes faster than internal product temperature; exact logger position and multiple mapped positions aid diagnosis.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Placement guidance varies with vehicle, load, product, package, and air-delivery configuration; trailer guidance is not universal for a small route.
sources.applicability: Supports separating local logger air from product-like measurements and recording exact positions/events.
sources.limitations: Extension guidance, not an experiment on this cooperative.

sources.title: Identifying cooling heterogeneity during precooling and refrigerated trailer transport for the citrus supply chain by extensive temperature monitoring within full-scale experiments
sources.authors_or_publisher: Celine Verreydt, Emmanuel Cobbinah-Sam, Ana Mikler Celis, Martin Meckesheimer, Nikos Prountzos, Raphael Sacher, Elisabeth Tobler, and Thijs Defraeye; Food Control
sources.released_version_or_commit: Version of record, November 2024, volume 165, article 110672; DOI 10.1016/j.foodcont.2024.110672.
sources.retrieval_operation: Opened WUR research record and read the primary article abstract and metadata.
sources.locator: Abstract lines 25–29 and publication metadata; see the record's DOI and CC BY access link.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: 108 sensors mapped one Greece–Switzerland commercial citrus shipment; rear-air/fruit measurements extended to 30 additional shipments. Some fruit missed the study target after 24 h room precooling and some middle-trailer fruit reheated with insufficient pallet ventilation.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Specific citrus, large trailer, route, setpoint, and room-precooling context.
sources.applicability: Supports spatial measurement and airflow/initial-condition hypotheses.
sources.limitations: No numeric target or cooling effect transfers to this unknown short route.

sources.title: Thermal Management of Short-Range Distribution of Perishable Food Products Using Phase Change Materials in Packaging: Real-Time Field Data Acquisition
sources.authors_or_publisher: Martim Aguiar, Pedro Dinis Gaspar, and Pedro Dinho da Silva; Energies
sources.released_version_or_commit: Version of record, 2023, volume 16(13), article 5191; DOI 10.3390/en16135191; CC BY.
sources.retrieval_operation: Read the publisher article page/search-rendered abstract, methods, and results.
sources.locator: Abstract; methods on crate/PCM, orange loading, van, and sensor positions; results on unloading and PCM/empty-alveoli comparisons.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Short-route orange-crate field comparison reported lower temperature variation with PCM and spikes at unloading; sensors were in/near crates.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Winter Portugal route, insulated van with reefer off, overnight crate conditioning near 5 °C; abstract says 8 hours while methods list 08:00–14:05.
sources.applicability: A bounded passive-packaging and event-logging comparator.
sources.limitations: Air near produce, not pulp or delivered-quality outcomes; reuse, autonomy, quantity, and matching conditions are open.

sources.title: Artificial fruit for monitoring the thermal history of horticultural produce in the cold chain
sources.authors_or_publisher: Thijs Defraeye, Wentao Wu, Kevin Prawiranto, Giuseppino Fortunato, Shelley Kemp, Stefan Hartmann, Paul Cronje, Pieter Verboven, and Bart Nicolai; Journal of Food Engineering
sources.released_version_or_commit: Version of record, December 2017, volume 215, pages 51–60; DOI 10.1016/j.jfoodeng.2017.07.012.
sources.retrieval_operation: Read the publisher abstract and introductory article record.
sources.locator: Abstract: prototype composition and comparison against ten apples during cooling.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Artificial-apple cooling time was within 5% of ten apples; water-filled simulators differed by up to 16%.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Apple-like prototype tested during cooling; simulator response must match the target crop and transition.
sources.applicability: Candidate for repeatable product-like mapping after crop-specific validation.
sources.limitations: Does not validate unknown produce, heating response, quality, or safety.

sources.title: Heat and mass exchanging processes in a refrigerated truck body during multi-drop urban distribution of fresh herbs
sources.authors_or_publisher: Vladimir N. Kornienko; Revista San Gregorio
sources.retrieval_operation: Read publisher abstract and linked English article record.
sources.locator: Abstract, study arrangement, and publication metadata.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: An 11 m³ refrigerated body with dill/parsley measured air parameters under varying door-open durations; heat gain calculation used an empty body.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Specific herbs, vehicle, and study sequence.
sources.applicability: Supports logging stop/open durations with temperature data.
sources.limitations: Not a quantitative prediction of produce-core or quality response here.

sources.title: Management of reusable plastic crates in fresh produce supply chains: A technical guide
sources.authors_or_publisher: Rosendo S. Rapusas and Rosa S. Rolle; FAO Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific
sources.retrieval_operation: Opened official FAO publication record and read title, metadata, and abstract.
sources.locator: Publication metadata and abstract, lines 2–24 and 37–40.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Guide scope includes good handling/storage practices, cleaning/sanitization protocols, and returnable-crate management.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Applies to reusable plastic-crate systems in horticultural chains.
sources.applicability: Useful for reconstructing crate ownership, repair, cleaning, pooling, and reuse if locally relevant.
sources.limitations: Not a thermal test and does not establish the cooperative's crate type.

sources.title: Cooling efficiency and effectiveness of single-crate evaporative cooler for selected fresh produce
sources.authors_or_publisher: Ryan Anthony O. Lualhati and Dormita R. Del Carmen; Philippine Journal of Crop Science
sources.released_version_or_commit: August 2018, volume 43, issue 2, pages 47–55; repository record 5138.
sources.retrieval_operation: Opened university repository record and read abstract and availability notice.
sources.locator: Abstract and issue metadata; repository says full document is unavailable there.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Abstract describes duck-cloth-wrapped plastic crate trials on lettuce, rambutan, bitter gourd, and eggplant.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Specific products and study setup; abstract does not provide sufficient local route/climate detail for transfer.
sources.applicability: Screening lead for a possible non-powered option after local matching.
sources.limitations: Full methods unavailable in the record; no result transfers to this case.

sources.title: Evaporative cooling with a wet fabric blanket for non-refrigerated horticultural produce transport: An experimental study
sources.authors_or_publisher: Nattawut Chaomuang, Onrawee Laguerre, Suriyan Supapvanich, Denis Flick, and Steven Duret; Journal of Agriculture and Food Research
sources.released_version_or_commit: Version of record, volume 18 (December 2024), article 101339; DOI 10.1016/j.jafr.2024.101339.
sources.retrieval_operation: Read publisher abstract and methods summary.
sources.locator: Abstract/method: cargo chamber, climate, airflow, duration, surrogate load, and separate lettuce mass-loss comparison.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Thai chamber at 29–30 °C and 70–73% RH, 0.8–3.6 m/s airflow, three-hour run with hollow plastic balls; separate lettuce mass-loss result; air drop about 3–4 °C.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Fixed tropical climate, simulated airflow, surrogate thermal load; result depends on humidity, airflow, water, package, and crop.
sources.applicability: A bounded non-powered screening option if local conditions and crop align.
sources.limitations: Does not show this route's product-core or quality response.

sources.title: Full-scale experiments in forced-air precoolers for citrus fruit: Impact of packaging design and fruit size on cooling rate and heterogeneity
sources.authors_or_publisher: Wentao Wu, Philippe Häller, Paul Cronjé, and Thijs Defraeye; Biosystems Engineering
sources.released_version_or_commit: Version of record, May 2018, volume 169, pages 115–125; DOI 10.1016/j.biosystemseng.2018.02.003.
sources.retrieval_operation: Read publisher abstract/search-rendered article content and accepted-manuscript metadata; full article text was not independently accessed.
sources.locator: Publisher abstract and conclusion summary; 40-pallet facility, citrus fruit, airflow heterogeneity, package/wrapping, and fruit/package comparisons.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Cooling heterogeneity mainly followed airflow direction; wrapping slowed cooling; the reported up-to-42% contrast includes Nova mandarins in Opentop cartons versus Eureka lemons in Supervent cartons.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Commercial citrus forced-air precooling, not a short insulated-crate route.
sources.applicability: Supports inspecting vents, liners/wrap, stacking, and airflow.
sources.limitations: The 42% contrast is not package-only; publisher full text was unavailable during this review. Do not transfer the effect size.

sources.title: A phase change material (PCM) based passively cooled container for integrated road-rail cold chain transportation – An experimental study
sources.authors_or_publisher: Shanhu Tong, Binjian Nie, Zixiao Li, Chunhai Li, Boyang Zou, Lin Jiang, Yi Jin, and Yulong Ding; Applied Thermal Engineering
sources.released_version_or_commit: Version of record, August 2021, volume 195, article 117204; DOI 10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2021.117204.
sources.locator: Abstract/highlights: separate charging facility, road–rail application, four fresh produce types, discharge duration.
sources.reported_behavior_or_method: Container with PCM storage plates and separate charging facility; reports discharge up to 94.6 hours.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Vehicle-scale long-distance road–rail equipment; conditions differ from a small crate route.
sources.applicability: Shows that passive cold storage still requires charging and sufficient thermal capacity.
sources.limitations: Abstract-level comparison; runtime/economic results do not transfer to this case.
